subject: Re: Cochlear implant pipeline kickoff — from hackathon code to accessibility demo
body:
Eval + pipeline status.

Pipeline (Milan): notebooks are now a proper batch pipeline — wav in, electrodograms out — with the enhancement stage and the causal YAMNet-gated mixing intact. Vocoder-simulation listening workflow is up, so we can actually hear what implant users would get.

Mixing-threshold study: the fixed-fraction baseline mixing is clearly worse than YAMNet gating — on our music-plus-speech test set, YAMNet-gated mixing preserves music segments the plain enhancement path strips out, at equivalent speech intelligibility scores (STOI within 0.01). Recommend we drop the fixed-fraction path from the demo entirely, one less thing to explain.

Risk for the retrain: Efe's dry runs show our current corpora skew clean-speech; music-adjacent samples are underrepresented vs what the mixing stage needs. He's assembling an augmentation set now — needs to be frozen two weeks before the June retrain week.

Halima
